name: Should I replace the bathtub with a walk-in shower in a guest bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace the bathtub with a walk-in shower in a guest bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a tub and a walk-in shower depends on your typical visitors and the other bathrooms in your home. A walk-in shower is ideal for adult visitors, overnight guests with limited mobility, and smaller spaces where an open design creates a larger visual footprint. However, keeping a bathtub is practical if your home lacks another tub or if visitors frequently bring small children. If the guest bath doubles as a secondary family bathroom, preserving a tub-and-shower combination provides daily flexibility, while a dedicated guest suite often benefits more from the accessible entry of a walk-in shower.
acceptedAnswer.description: A walk-in shower offers easier access and a modern look for adult guests, but keeping a tub is better if you have young children or lack another bathtub in the house.
